name: excel-csv
description: Local CSV/TSV and XLSX files: list sheets, read rows (sheet, A1 range, header row, row cap; formulas as values), write and convert, with CSV-injection protection

nodes.title: List sheets
nodes.description: Lists an .xlsx workbook's sheets with their 1-based index, visibility and used row/column counts

input.description: .csv, .tsv, .txt or .xlsx file inside EXCEL_CSV_INPUT_DIRS (or EXCEL_CSV_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Read a table
nodes.description: Reads rows from a CSV/TSV file or an XLSX sheet (optionally an A1 range). Formula cells give their saved results, dates ISO strings. Rows come as objects keyed by the header row, or as arrays

input.description: .csv, .tsv, .txt or .xlsx file inside EXCEL_CSV_INPUT_DIRS (or EXCEL_CSV_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

sheet.description: XLSX sheet name or 1-based index (default: the first sheet)

range.description: XLSX A1 range such as A1:F200 (default: the used area)

header_row.description: Row (1-based, within the range) holding column names; 0 means none (columns become column_1, column_2, ...)

max_rows.description: Most data rows returned (also capped by EXCEL_CSV_MAX_ROWS)

delimiter.description: CSV delimiter (reading default: auto-detect, tab for .tsv; writing default: ,)

row_format.description: Rows as objects keyed by column name, or as arrays

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Write a table
nodes.description: Writes rows (objects or arrays) to a new CSV or XLSX file in EXCEL_CSV_OUTPUT_DIR. XLSX cells are always literal values, never formulas; CSV cells that look like formulas are neutralised

rows.description: Rows: objects (keys become columns) or arrays of values

columns.description: Column order and header row (default: the objects' keys; none for arrays)

delimiter.description: CSV delimiter (reading default: auto-detect, tab for .tsv; writing default: ,)

csv_injection_protection.description: Prefix CSV cells starting with = + - @ tab or CR with ' so spreadsheet apps do not run them as formulas. Only workflow nodes may turn this off

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Convert CSV and XLSX
nodes.description: Converts a CSV/TSV file to XLSX (decimal text becomes numbers unless keep_text) or an XLSX sheet to CSV; writes a new file

input.description: .csv, .tsv, .txt or .xlsx file inside EXCEL_CSV_INPUT_DIRS (or EXCEL_CSV_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

sheet.description: XLSX sheet name or 1-based index (default: the first sheet)

delimiter.description: Delimiter of the CSV side: read from (default auto-detect) or written (default ,)

keep_text.description: CSV to XLSX: keep every cell as text

csv_injection_protection.description: Prefix CSV cells starting with = + - @ tab or CR with ' so spreadsheet apps do not run them as formulas. Only workflow nodes may turn this off

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
